about: The source model of a Hamamatsu NDPI slide (spec/virtualize/ndpi.md <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ndpi.md>): a little-endian classic TIFF with 64-bit offsets (an 8-byte first-IFD offset, 8-byte next-IFD offsets, a high word per entry after each IFD) whose levels are single JPEG strips with restart markers. The TIFF parser reads it in its NDPI variant (rust/refkv-ir/src/tiff.rs) and checks this schema where the profile meets each role; the strip's JPEG header and its restart intervals are read by rust/refkv-ir/src/ndpi.rs. Projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

kinds.about: the field types a tag of each kind may have

tags.about: The tags of the table (spec/virtualize/ndpi.md §2 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ndpi.md#2-the-source>): kind (the field types allowed), scalar (the first value is read, and there must be one).

elements.about: The IR of an NDPI file (spec/virtualize/ndpi.md §5.1 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ndpi.md#51-elements>). Names in angle brackets are variables.

ifds/<i>.about: the main chain; the IFDs pointer tags lead to (SubIFDs among them) are subifds/<j>, exif, gps, interoperability or ifd_<tag> (/<j> when the tag has several values), read in NDPI's layout; an IFD read before is an alias

children.tags/<tag>: struct of entry {tag,type,count[,offset][,field]}, value (in the value field, or at its 64-bit offset) and high (<u4: the entry's high word); a duplicate tag is tags/<tag>~<k>
children.strips/<k>: data: a strip of StripOffsets (64-bit) and StripByteCounts with a byte count above 0 within the file; a level's strip is one JPEG stream, cut into chunks by the projection along McuStarts

ifd_offset.about: a main-chain IFD, checked before its entries are read

given.count_within: its entry count is within the file
given.within: its entries, next offset and high words are within the file (known after the count)

constraints.message: IFD offset {offset} is not in the file
IFD offset {offset} read twice
too many IFDs
the IFD at {offset} is not within the file
the IFD at {offset} is not within the file

field.about: the first entry of a tag of the table, in every main-chain IFD

given.outside: out of line, and its bytes (at its 64-bit offset) do not end within the file

constraints.message: tag {tag} has field type {type}
tag {tag} has no value
the value of tag {tag} is outside the file

values.about: an integer tag's values as the profile reads them (a scalar's first value, an array's every value; an inline LONG or IFD of count 1 with its high word)

given.safe: every value read is at most 2^53 - 1

constraints.message: tag {tag} has a value above 2^53 - 1

required.about: a tag the profile needs a value of

constraints.message: an NDPI image has no {what}
no NDPI levels

level.about: a main-chain IFD whose Magnification is positive (spec/virtualize/ndpi.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ndpi.md#3-levels>)

given.one_strip: StripOffsets and StripByteCounts have one value each
given.smaller: strictly smaller than the level before in both sizes (true for the first)
given.new_magnification: no earlier level has its Magnification

constraints.require: compression == 7 && photometric == 6 && spp == 3 && len(bits) >= 1 && distinct(bits) == 1 && first(bits) == 8
constraints.message: an NDPI level is not 8-bit YCbCr JPEG with 3 samples
an NDPI level does not have exactly one strip
NDPI levels do not decrease in size
NDPI focal planes (two levels with one magnification) are not supported
an NDPI level is empty

strip.about: a level's strip, the JPEG stream S

constraints.message: an NDPI strip is outside the file
an NDPI strip of {length} bytes is shorter than 4

mcu_starts.about: a level's McuStarts (and McuStartsHighBytes), before its header is read

given.same_length: McuStartsHighBytes is absent or has as many values
given.first: M[0] (absent when McuStarts has no value)

constraints.message: McuStartsHighBytes and McuStarts differ in length
McuStarts[0] is outside the strip

jpeg_segment.about: a marker segment of the strip's header (its first M[0] bytes), from after the SOI to SOS

given.whole: a marker FF, its length of at least 2, and its end within the header
given.ends_header: it ends where the header ends

constraints.message: malformed JPEG header in an NDPI strip
an NDPI strip has two SOF0 segments
an NDPI strip is not baseline JPEG (marker FF{hex})
malformed DRI segment in an NDPI strip
an NDPI strip's SOS does not end at McuStarts[0]

jpeg_header.about: the strip's header: its start, then, after its segments, the whole

given.done: the segments have been read (the rest is given then)
given.restart: the DRI's restart interval R (0 when absent)
given.sof0_ok: the SOF0 segment is 10 + 3 × its component count bytes long, with at least one component
given.sampling: the largest horizontal and vertical sampling factors are both above 0

constraints.message: an NDPI strip does not start with a JPEG SOI marker
an NDPI strip has no SOF0 or no restart interval
malformed SOF0 segment in an NDPI strip
an NDPI strip has a sampling factor of 0

given.matches: McuStarts has q × r values, increasing, the last before len(S)
given.nonempty: every interval holds at least one byte

constraints.message: McuStarts does not match the strip's intervals
an NDPI restart interval is empty

chunks.about: a McuStarts level's chunks, a × b intervals each: their width before b is chosen, then their height and largest payload at the b chosen

given.height: b × mh (0 before b is chosen)
given.payload: the largest chunk's reference payload (0 before b is chosen)

constraints.message: an NDPI chunk would be {width} pixels wide, more than {max_side}
an NDPI chunk would be {height} pixels high, more than {max_side}
an NDPI chunk's reference payload exceeds {max_payload} bytes

translation.about: the image's translation, when it has one

constraints.message: a translation is not finite

about_builtins: What the parser's code computes and the roles above check: detection (spec/virtualize/ndpi.md §4 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/virtualize/ndpi.md#4-ndpi-profile>: a little-endian magic-42 TIFF whose IFD at the u64 at bytes 4-11 has tag 65420 among its entries; it never rejects); the main chain in NDPI's IFD layout (each next offset, a u64, until 0); each value with its high word; the levels (main-chain IFDs whose Magnification is positive, every IFD's Magnification read); the strip's JPEG header (its marker segments, SOF0's sampling factors, DRI's restart interval); the intervals and the chunk size a × b (b the largest within the payload limit).
